Keep facts (sizes, materials, ages, origin) exactly as in the Vietnamese listing. `products` is keyed by product id; `source` is the hash of the Vietnamese title and description the text was translated from: when an import changes them, the English page shows Vietnamese again and `npm run check` names the product and its new hash, so re-check the translation and update `source`. `skuNames`, `attributeNames` and `attributeValues` translate exact Vietnamese wording; anything not listed is shown as it is (names like Frieren or Kafka need no entry). `note` is for the reviewer and never shown.
